title: numberwall_background not loaded on app start/phone reboot
symptom: After phone reboot and xDrip starts, the number wall background image is not displayed on the lock screen and is not shown in the 'Number Wall on Lock Screen' settings area. The image disappears as soon as xDrip starts after a reboot.
cause: The issue is that xDrip holds the path for the original image and for some reason it becomes null. Possibly due to external storage permission not being available at boot time.
fix: The proposed fix is to copy the chosen image to the app's internal storage so the app always has a valid image file.
evidence_quote: I think the issue is that xDrip holds the path for the original image and for some reason it becomes null. I'm trying to get the chosen image and copy it to the app's internal storage. That way the app will always have a valid image file.
